Summary

COUSR00C is a CICS online program within the CardDemo application that displays a paginated list of users from the USRSEC security file, showing up to 10 users per page with their ID, name, and type. The program allows administrators to navigate through user records using PF7 (backward) and PF8 (forward) keys, and to select a user for update (U) or delete (D) operations by transferring control to the respective programs (COUSR02C or COUSR03C). It is a main/driver program that manages its own screen flow and communicates with other programs via a shared communication area.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize all flags and variables to their default states, including error flag (off), end-of-file flag (not EOF), next-page flag (no), and erase flag (yes). Clear message and error message fields. 2: Session Validation - Check if a valid user session exists (communication area length). If no session exists, redirect the user to the sign-on screen (COSGN00C). 3: First-Time Screen Display - On the first entry into the program, mark the program as re-entered, clear the screen output area, and load the first page of users to display. 4: User Input Reception - Receive the user list screen input, capturing any selection flags, user ID search criteria, and function key pressed by the user. 5: Function Key Routing - Evaluate which key the user pressed (Enter, PF3, PF7, PF8, or other) and route to the appropriate processing logic. 6: Invalid Key Handling - If an unsupported key is pressed, set an error flag and display the message 'Invalid key' on the user list screen. 7: Navigation to Admin Menu - When PF3 is pressed, transfer control back to the administration menu screen (COADM01C). 8: User Selection Detection - When Enter is pressed, scan all 10 rows on the screen to identify if the user has entered a selection code (U or D) next to any listed user. 9: Navigate to Update User - If the user selects 'U' or 'u' next to a user record, transfer control to the Update User program (COUSR02C) passing the selected user ID. 10: Navigate to Delete User - If the user selects 'D' or 'd' next to a user record, transfer control to the Delete User program (COUSR03C) passing the selected user ID. 11: Invalid Selection Validation - If the user enters a selection code other than U or D, display the message 'Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D'. 12: User ID Search Criteria Handling - Capture the user ID entered in the search field; if blank, start browsing from the beginning of the user file. 13: Page Forward Navigation (Enter Key) - Reset the page number to zero and load the next page of users starting from the specified or default user ID. 14: Page Backward Navigation (PF7) - When PF7 is pressed, check if the current page number is greater than 1. If yes, navigate to the previous page of users. If already on the first page, display 'You are already at the top of the page...'. 15: Page Forward Navigation (PF8) - When PF8 is pressed, check if a next page exists. If yes, navigate to the next page of users. If already on the last page, display 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'. 16: Forward Page Data Loading - Open a browse on the user security file starting at the specified user ID, read up to 10 user records sequentially, populate the screen rows, and determine if a further next page exists. 17: Backward Page Data Loading - Open a browse on the user security file starting at the specified user ID, read up to 10 user records in reverse order, populate the screen rows in reverse, and adjust the page number accordingly. 18: Screen Row Initialization - Clear all 10 user rows on the screen (user ID, first name, last name, user type) before populating with new data. 19: User Record Population - For each user record read, populate the corresponding screen row with the user's ID, first name, last name, and user type. Track the first and last user IDs displayed for pagination purposes. 20: Page Number Tracking - Maintain and display the current page number on the screen, incrementing when moving forward and decrementing when moving backward. 21: Next Page Availability Indicator - After loading a page, attempt to read one additional record to determine if more records exist beyond the current page, setting the next-page flag accordingly. 22: First and Last User ID Tracking - Store the user ID of the first record and the last record displayed on the current page to support forward and backward pagination. 23: Screen Header Population - Populate the screen header with the application title, transaction ID, program name, current date (MM/DD/YY), and current time (HH:MM:SS). 24: User List Screen Display - Send the populated user list screen to the terminal, displaying up to 10 users with their IDs, names, and types, along with the page number and any messages. 25: End of File Notification - When the bottom of the user list is reached while paging forward, display the message 'You have reached the bottom of the page...'. 26: Top of File Notification - When the top of the user list is reached while paging backward, display the message 'You have reached the top of the page...'. 27: Session State Preservation - Return control to the transaction with the updated communication area, preserving page state, selected user, pagination flags, and first/last user IDs for the next interaction.

## 1. Screen Initialization and First Entry ```cobol MAIN-PARA. MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE ERRMSGO OF COUSR0AO MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR0AI IF EIBCALEN = 0 MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN ELSE MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR0AO PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY PERFORM SEND-USRLST-SCREEN ``` **Purpose:** On first entry, clears the screen output map (COUSR0AO), sets cursor to the Search User ID field (USRIDINL=-1), and sends the user list screen. --- ## 2. Receiving Screen Input ```cobol RECEIVE-USRLST-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COUSR0A') MAPSET('COUSR00') INTO(COUSR0AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` **Purpose:** Receives all user input from the COUSR0A map (including Search User ID field USRIDINI and all 10 selection fields SEL0001I–SEL0010I) into the COUSR0AI input structure. --- ## 3. Sending the User List Screen ```cobol SEND-USRLST-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COUSR0AO IF SEND-ERASE-YES EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COUSR0A') MAPSET('COUSR00') FROM(COUSR0AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC ELSE EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COUSR0A') MAPSET('COUSR00') FROM(COUSR0AO) CURSOR END-EXEC END-IF. ``` **Purpose:** Sends the populated COUSR0AO output map to the terminal. Uses ERASE when displaying a fresh screen; omits ERASE for partial refreshes (e.g., error messages on backward/forward navigation boundaries). --- ## 4. Populating Header Fields ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COUSR0AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COUSR0AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COUSR0AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COUSR0AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COUSR0AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COUSR0AO. ``` **Purpose:** Populates the screen header fields: TITLE01O (Title Line 1), TITLE02O (Title Line 2), TRNNAMEO (Transaction ID), PGMNAMEO (Program Name), CURDATEO (Current Date), CURTIMEO (Current Time). --- ## 5. Processing Enter Key – Reading Selection Fields ```cobol PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. EVALUATE TRUE WHEN SEL0001I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0001I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID01I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0002I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0002I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID02I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0003I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0003I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID03I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0004I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0004I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID04I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0005I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0005I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID05I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0006I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0006I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID06I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0007I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0007I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID07I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0008I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0008I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID08I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0009I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0009I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID09I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN SEL0010I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE SEL0010I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE USRID10I OF COUSR0AI TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED WHEN OTHER MOVE SPACES TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG MOVE SPACES TO CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED END-EVALUATE ``` **Purpose:** Reads the 10 selection fields (SEL0001I–SEL0010I) from the screen. When a non-blank selection is found, captures the selection flag and the corresponding User ID (USRID01I–USRID10I) for further processing. --- ## 6. Processing Selection Action (Update or Delete) ```cobol IF (CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES) AND (CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES) EVALUATE CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG WHEN 'U' WHEN 'u' MOVE 'COUSR02C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM MOVE WS-TRANID TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM MOVE 0 TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) END-EXEC WHEN 'D' WHEN 'd' MOVE 'COUSR03C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM MOVE WS-TRANID TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM MOVE 0 TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) END-EXEC WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR0AI END-EVALUATE END-IF ``` **Purpose:** Based on the selection flag entered by the user ('U'/'u' or 'D'/'d'), transfers control to the Update User program (COUSR02C) or Delete User program (COUSR03C). Invalid selections display an error message in the ERRMSG field. --- ## 7. Reading Search User ID Input ```cobol IF USRIDINI OF COUSR0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE LOW-VALUES TO SEC-USR-ID ELSE MOVE USRIDINI OF COUSR0AI TO SEC-USR-ID END-IF MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR0AI ``` **Purpose:** Reads the Search User ID field (USRIDINI) entered by the user. If blank, sets the search key to LOW-VALUES (start of file). Sets cursor position back to the Search User ID field. --- ## 8. Populating User Data Rows on Screen (Forward) ```cobol POPULATE-USER-DATA. EVALUATE WS-IDX WHEN 1 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID01I OF COUSR0AI CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME01I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME01I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE01I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 2 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID02I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME02I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME02I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE02I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 3 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID03I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME03I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME03I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE03I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 4 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID04I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME04I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME04I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE04I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 5 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID05I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME05I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME05I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE05I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 6 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID06I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME06I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME06I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE06I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 7 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID07I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME07I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME07I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE07I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 8 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID08I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME08I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME08I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE08I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 9 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID09I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME09I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME09I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE09I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 10 MOVE SEC-USR-ID TO USRID10I OF COUSR0AI CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAME10I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAME10I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO UTYPE10I OF COUSR0AI WHEN OTHER CONTINUE END-EVALUATE. ``` **Purpose:** Populates each of the 10 user data rows on the screen (USRID01I–USRID10I, FNAME01I–FNAME10I, LNAME01I–LNAME10I, UTYPE01I–UTYPE10I) with data read from the USRSEC file. Also tracks the first and last User IDs displayed for pagination. --- ## 9. Clearing User Data Rows on Screen ```cobol INITIALIZE-USER-DATA. EVALUATE WS-IDX WHEN 1 MOVE SPACES TO USRID01I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SPACES TO FNAME01I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SPACES TO LNAME01I OF COUSR0AI MOVE SPACES TO UTYPE01I OF COUSR0AI WHEN 2 MOVE SPACES TO USRID02I OF COUSR0AI ... [WHEN 3 through 10 - same pattern] END-EVALUATE. ``` **Purpose:** Clears all 10 user data rows on the screen before repopulating them with a new page of data, ensuring no stale data remains from the previous page. --- ## 10. Updating Page Number on Screen ```cobol MOVE CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM TO PAGENUMI OF COUSR0AI ``` **Purpose:** Updates the Page Number field (PAGENUMI) on the screen with the current page number after forward or backward navigation. --- ## 11. Clearing Search User ID Output Field ```cobol MOVE SPACE TO USRIDINO OF COUSR0AO ``` **Purpose:** Clears the Search User ID output field (USRIDINO) on the screen after a successful search/navigation, so the field appears blank to the user. --- ## 12. Displaying Error Messages ```cobol MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COUSR0AO ``` **Purpose:** Moves the current error or informational message into the ERRMSG output field (ERRMSGO) on the screen. Messages include invalid key presses, navigation boundary messages, and invalid selection codes. --- ## 13. Key Press Handling (PF3, PF7, PF8, Invalid Key) ```cobol EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY WHEN DFHPF3 MOVE 'COADM01C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF7 PERFORM PROCESS-PF7-KEY WHEN DFHPF8 PERFORM PROCESS-PF8-KEY WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR0AI MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-USRLST-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ``` **Purpose:** Routes user key presses to the appropriate processing routines. PF3 returns to the Admin menu. PF7 pages backward. PF8 pages forward. Invalid keys display the "Invalid key pressed" message in the ERRMSG field and set cursor to the Search User ID field. --- ## 14. PF7 (Page Backward) Boundary Check ```cobol PROCESS-PF7-KEY. IF CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM > 1 PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD ELSE MOVE 'You are already at the top of the page...' TO WS-MESSAGE SET SEND-ERASE-NO TO TRUE PERFORM SEND-USRLST-SCREEN END-IF. ``` **Purpose:** If already on page 1, displays "You are already at the top of the page..." in the ERRMSG field without erasing the screen. Otherwise, navigates to the previous page. --- ## 15. PF8 (Page Forward) Boundary Check ```cobol PROCESS-PF8-KEY. IF NEXT-PAGE-YES PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD ELSE MOVE 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' TO WS-MESSAGE SET SEND-ERASE-NO TO TRUE PERFORM SEND-USRLST-SCREEN END-IF. ``` **Purpose:** If there is no next page available, displays "You are already at the bottom of the page..." in the ERRMSG field without erasing the screen. Otherwise, navigates to the next page.
